title: A Gecko Can Hang From the Ceiling by a Single Toe

scenes.text: A gecko can hold its whole body up with one toe.
Its feet are covered in millions of microscopic hairs.
Each hair splits into about a thousand even tinier pads.
They stick using forces between molecules, not glue.
A million of them, on a dime-sized patch, could lift a small child.
Whole body. One toe. No glue.

description:
A gecko can support its whole body on a single toe.
Each foot has millions of microscopic hairs called setae, and each hair ends in about 1,000 tiny pads. They stick through weak molecular forces rather than glue, so the foot lets go instantly when the gecko lifts it.
What would you build with gecko tape? Tell us.
thumbnail_text: ONE TOE HOLDS A WHOLE GECKO
first_comment: Oregon State scientists found the forces could support about 50 times the gecko's body weight. Spider-Man would be jealous. Agree?
